title: Water finds the low bank
odia:
ଉଣା ହିଡ ଯେଉଁଠି
ପାଣି ଗଡ଼େ ସେଇଠି।
literal_meaning: Where the embankment is low, that is where the water flows.
meaning_odia: ହିଡ଼ର ନିମ୍ନ ଅଂଶ ଦେଇ ପାଣି ବାହାରିଯାଏ। ସେହି ଚିତ୍ରରୁ ଦୁର୍ବଳ ଜାଗାରେ ଚାପ ପଡ଼ିବା ବା ସେହି ବାଟେ କ୍ଷତି ଘଟିବାର କଥାକୁ ଏଠାରେ ପଢ଼ାଯାଇଛି।
explanation: An embankment may hold water along most of its length, but a lower section gives the water a way through. This edition reads the image as a reminder that pressure finds a weak point. A small vulnerable part can determine what happens to the whole arrangement.
usage_example: A group prepares carefully for an event but leaves one essential task without an owner. When that gap disrupts the work, someone might recall the water finding a low bank. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: ହିଡ is the raised earthen boundary or bank that holds back water. The verse focuses on a difference in height: the lower part becomes the outlet. Pairing ଯେଉଁଠି with ସେଇଠି makes the connection between vulnerable place and flowing water immediate.
